summary: Fixed #1207: compiler warnings can no longer use up a node's output cap and hide the error that failed it. In `cli/internal/commands/controlbus/problems.go`, `problemFilter.admit` now gives each node two separate budgets. ERROR lines keep the old cap of 20. WARN lines get a smaller cap of 10 (new constant `maxWarnLinesPerNode`). Each budget prints its own "more problem lines suppressed" notice when full. Added `TestProblemFilter_warningsNeverCrowdOutTheError` to `problems_test.go`: it sends 25 warnings and then one error, and checks that the warnings stop at the cap plus a notice and the error is still printed. `./gradlew :cli:goTest` passes. I did not run `:cli:check` (format, vet, lint, the 100% per-function coverage rule); the workflow's full gate will. The PR text is in `.yukta-dev/pr.md`.
